forcedCategories.description: Ruleset ids that cannot be disabled on this device. Valid values: sitr_gambling, sitr_dating. (Adult and SafeSearch are always on for every user.)

managedBlockDomains.description: Domains blocked organization-wide (bare lowercase domains, e.g. example.com).

managedAllowDomains.description: Domains allowed organization-wide. A managed allow outranks household and device rules but NOT a managed block.

lockOptions.description: When true, the options page is read-only on this device.
